passages.original: V. Quod gratia Dei praestet ut lex impleatur, non sicut ait Pelagius facile, quasi sine gratia Dei difficilius possit impleri.
passages.english: 5. That the grace of God brings it about that the law is fulfilled, and not, as Pelagius says, [that it is fulfilled] easily, as though without the grace of God it could be fulfilled [only] with greater difficulty.
